31619b2a01.q: What educational gap exists for physicians regarding menopause in their medical training?
31619b2a01.a: Physicians receive only two hours of education about menopause throughout their entire medical education. This significant gap contributes to the underdiagnosis and undertreatment of menopausal symptoms, which Vanessa is working to address through TeliRx's menopause awareness programs.
